item.title: First snow of the season is coming to Northeast
item.description: Parts of the Northeast could see their first snowfall of the season later this week, as a cold snap spreads over the eastern half of the U.S.

item.title: Pope Leo visits Argentina on second leg of expansive Latin America tour after lung surgery
item.description: Pope Leo visited Argentina, the home country of the late Pope Francis, as part of an expansive tour of South America that's followed his lung surgery. Chris Livesay has more.

item.title: These House and Senate midterm races don't have winners yet
item.description: Democrats won sizable House and Senate majorities in the 2026 midterm elections, but the exact margins are unclear because some races haven't been projected yet. Here's where the results stand.

item.title: More than 200 million brace for coldest temperatures of the season
item.description: Millions are bracing for severe weather as a possible nor'easter is set to bring cold temperatures and the first snow of the season to parts of the northeastern United States. Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Nvidia's trillion-dollar bind: Can it afford to lose Jensen Huang?
item.description: Other CEOs have been ousted over undisclosed relationships, but Nvidia's inquiry shines a spotlight on how closely the chipmaker's fortunes are tied to its co-founder.

item.title: Nvidia shares plummet again amid CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
item.description: Nvidia's stock fell again on Tuesday, bringing its total two-day losses to nearly $500 million as the company grapples with CEO Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Jo Lin Kent reports.

item.title: Meghan Markle's father cut off ankle monitor, prosecutors say
item.description: Bill Essayli, the first assistant U.S. attorney, asked for Markle's bail to be revoked and for him to be detained pending trial.

item.title: Meghan Markle's father back in custody after allegedly cutting his ankle monitor
item.description: Meghan Markle's father, Thomas Markle, is back in custody after allegedly cutting his ankle monitor following his arrest for alleged possession of child sexual abuse material. Leigh Kiniry has the story.

item.title: Police arrest man accused of raping at least 3 women in Central Park
item.description: Police have arrested a man in Miami Beach after he was accused of three rapes in New York City's Central Park, dating back to 2021. Lilia Luciano has more.

item.title: Matthew Farwell facing mandatory life sentence after Sandra Birchmore murder conviction
item.description: Former police officer Matthew Farwell is facing a mandatory sentence of life in prison for the murder of Sandra Birchmore and her unborn child after he was convicted Tuesday. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Why did Hegseth face an impeachment push? Inside the 8 articles
item.description: The impeachment resolution focuses on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's involvement in some of the most controversial episodes of President Trump's second term.

item.title: State seeks to block Pike's lawyers from inspecting execution drug
item.description: Tennessee is seeking to block Christa Pike's attorneys from accessing the pentobarbital used in the 50-year-old inmate's botched execution on the grounds that it would reveal the supplier.

item.title: House blocks Massie's effort to impeach Hegseth
item.description: GOP Rep. Thomas Massie said Monday he would not bring up another resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: U.S. soldier accused of spying linked to Russia arrested in the U.K.
item.description: A U.S. official told CBS News the suspect is a senior officer based at Imjin Barracks, home to the headquarters for NATO's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps.

item.title: Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang facing shareholder suit over affair with alleged Chinese spy
item.description: Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang are now facing a shareholder lawsuit over Huang's affair with an accused Chinese spy. CBS News contributor Patrick McGee has more.

item.title: Senior U.S. soldier arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia, FBI says
item.description: A senior U.S. army soldier based in the United Kingdom has been arrested over "allegations of espionage," FBI director Kash Patel said. Charlie D'Agata has more.

item.title: House GOP blocks Hegseth impeachment measure introduced by Massie
item.description: Every House Republican except Rep. Thomas Massie voted to spare Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth from an impeachment measure amid accusations that he knowingly executed unlawful orders tied to the war with Iran. Caitlin Huey-Burns reports.

item.title: Democrats Christina Hines, Marni von Wilpert and Zach Dembo on priorities as they enter Congress
item.description: CBS News' Ed O'Keefe speaks with three of the new Democrats who will join Congress in its next term: Michigan's Christina Hines, California's Marni von Wilpert and Kentucky's Zach Dembo.

item.title: Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders on Republicans' major midterm losses: "Has to be a wake up call"
item.description: Arkansas GOP Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders joins "The Takeout" to share her thoughts on Republicans' sweeping losses in last week's midterm elections.

item.title: Live Updates: GOP picks leaders, blocks Hegseth impeachment
item.description: House and Senate Republicans held internal elections for their leadership teams on Tuesday as they prepare to become the minority in January.

item.title: Rep. Stephen Lynch on how Democrats plan to investigate Trump during the next Congress
item.description: Democrats preparing to take over Congress in the new year are promising aggressive oversight of the Trump administration. Democratic Rep. Stephen Lynch, a member of the House Oversight Committee, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Hegseth decries impeachment effort with vote expected tonight
item.description: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie said a vote in the House is expected later Tuesday on the impeachment resolutions against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Study shows who is hit hardest by data center costs
item.description: A new study found that lower-income, rural households bore a disproportionate share of the financial burdens associated with AI data centers and the energy they use.

item.title: 11/10: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: The House votes on an impeachment measure against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth; Republicans elect new congressional leaders.

item.title: DOC NYC documentary film festival returns. Check out this year's lineup.
item.description: America's largest festival for nonfiction cinema, with more than 115 feature-length documentaries plus short film programs, opens in NYC theaters and streams online.

item.title: FDA warns of rare vision-loss side effect from GLP-1 drugs
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration is adding a new warning about possible rare cases of vision loss reported with GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic, Wegovy and other brands.

item.title: GLP-1s must now include warning for potential increased risk of vision loss, FDA announces
item.description: The FDA announced that GLP-1 weight loss drugs will now include warning labels indicating a potential increased risk of vision loss.

item.title: Massie introduces Hegseth impeachment articles, teeing up vote
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie on Monday introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war against Iran without congressional authorization.

item.title: Is It Too Late to Save Humans from AI? With Bill Gates
item.description: Bill Gates led the last technological revolution. Now he's warning that AI is more dangerous than nuclear weapons, and that the next four years are critical. If you'd like to share your own great question, email us at greatquestion@cbsnews.com.

item.title: Democrat Xavier Becerra wins California governor's race, CBS News projects
item.description: Democrat Xavier Becerra will become California's next governor, CBS News projects, defeating Republican challenger Steve Hilton in a race that centered on the state's high cost of living, housing affordability, energy policy and relations with the federal government.
